subject: Usability Design of Software Applications
text: A company has developed a new online learning platform with advanced features like AI-driven recommendations, real-time collaboration, and interactive quizzes. However, after launching, the company receives complaints from users saying that the platform is difficult to navigate, the buttons are confusing, and important features are hard to find. As a result many users stop using the platform within a few days, even though it has strong technical capabilities. Based on the above scenario, explain why usability is critical in software development. What usability principles should the development team focus on to improve user experience and ensure the success of the platform?

subject: Usability Design of Software Applications
text: An e-commerce website has launched a new interface. Customers complain that: • The search bar does not give relevant suggestions, making it hard to find products. • The “Add to Cart” button looks different on each page confusing users. • When a payment fails, the error message only shows “Error 404” without guidance. • The website loads slowly, and some links take users to unrelated pages. Identify which of Nielsen’s heuristic functions are compromised in above scenarios. Suggest improvements.

subject: Usability Design of Software Applications
text: A hospital management system was recently introduced to help doctors and nurses record patient data digitally. While the system has all the required functions, staff members complain that entering information takes too long, menus are complicated, and error messages are unclear. As a result, medical staff avoid using the system and return to manual paperwork, which delays patient care. In this scenario, discuss why usability is essential for the success of software in critical environments like healthcare. What usability improvements could be made to increase adoption and efficiency of the hospital management system?

subject: Usability Design of Software Applications

Identify which of Nielsen’s heuristic functions are compromised in above scenarios. Suggest improvements.
